I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Social and Political Sciences
at Bocconi University, where I direct the
[AI in Social Science Research Lab (AISS)](ai-society.qmd).

My research studies:

(i) how technological change reshapes labor markets, politics, and demography;
(ii) emigration selection at origin;
(iii) education;
(iv) job amenities.

I am a Research Fellow at [CESifo](https://www.cesifo.org/en),
[IZA](http://www.iza.org/profile?key=21610), the
[ROCKWOOL Foundation Berlin](https://www.rfberlin.com/), the
[Dondena Centre](https://dondena.unibocconi.eu/),
[IGIER](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/),
[Baffi Carefin](https://bafficarefin.unibocconi.eu/), and the
[Fondazione Rodolfo DeBenedetti](https://www.frdb.org/en/).
